sources.title: Transformational Intelligence: Learning to Change the Game
sources.read_scope: Full substantive manuscript including methods, results, limitations and reproduction; source not newly executed by this reading.
sources.mechanism_used: Separate purpose, inherited formulation and evaluator. Diagnose a binding restriction, build an executable replacement, preserve original outcome obligations, state a falsifier, freeze and evaluate.
sources.claim_boundary: Exact causal model is matched by an unrestricted conventional planner. It is not a measured frontier-AI improvement.

sources.title: Invent the Economy: Transformational Intelligence for Creating Viable Markets
sources.read_scope: Full substantive manuscript including methods, results, limitations and reproduction; source not newly executed by this reading.
sources.mechanism_used: Construct capability and voluntary delivery arrangement together. Separate technical possibility, modeled viability, accepted agreement, realized exchange and repeatable market. Check individual participation, common failure and every cash prefix.
sources.claim_boundary: The positive four-buyer model supplies costs, participants and probabilities. It does not discover real buyers or establish demand.

sources.title: Transformational Autonomous Enterprises: SUCCESSOR Omega Harness
sources.read_scope: Full substantive manuscript including methods, results, limitations and reproduction; source not newly executed by this reading.
sources.mechanism_used: Retain immutable executable structure and evaluator-owned generic qualification while rechecking each new mission input, output and semantic contract. Current proof and authority are separate and not inherited.
sources.claim_boundary: Generic qualification reuse lowers repeated checks. The direct specialist ties quality and wins several complete-work measures; no commercial superiority follows.

connection: Change the formulation; construct a capability and viable arrangement; transfer the actual retained structure while rechecking fresh mission meaning and granting authority separately.
